payload.title: Prioritize section triage and reporting effort within editorial budgets
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a section editor, I want section-level prioritization and budget awareness for slower expensive work, so that reporting effort is allocated according to editorial value.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Prioritize section triage and reporting effort within editorial budgets
  Scenario: Prioritize expensive work
    Given multiple nominated candidates and a section's editorial priorities and budget policy
    When the section or desk editor plans triage and reporting
    Then higher-capability triage and reporting work are prioritized with an attributed allocation rationale
    And held or deferred candidates remain visible with their reasons
    And classifier eligibility alone does not commit reporting effort or confer ownership
  Scenario: Budget controls are undecided
    Given dollar amounts, hard-cap enforcement and concurrency policy have not been agreed
    When the planning design is reviewed
    Then those decisions remain explicit open questions
    And no spending authority or hard enforcement guarantee is inferred
```

Budget amounts, currency accounting, hard caps, scheduling and concurrency are undecided implementation-design questions. No purchase, model run or reporting dispatch is authorized by this planning record.
